# Changed enrollment facts conflict with the original enrollment

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. Enroll an Asset

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>

```json
}
```

## 2. Retrying with a different alias conflicts

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",
  "request_id": "<asset request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<asset credential>",
  "alias": "Other",
  "subtype": "ground vehicle",
  "components": {
    "telemetry": {
      "latitude": 42.2743,
      "longitude": -71.8081
    },
    "health": {
      "battery_percent": 75
    }
  },
  "command_manifest": [
    {
      "command_id": "move_to",
      "scheduling": [
        "queued"
      ],
      "cancellation": true,
      "progress": true
    }
  ]
}
```

→ **409**
```json
{
  "code": "registration_conflict",
  "message": "The registration identity or facts conflict."
}
```

## 6. Another credential cannot claim the Asset ID

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",
  "request_id": "<impostor request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<impostor credential>",
  "alias": "Impostor"
}
```

→ **409**
```json
{
  "code": "registration_conflict",
  "message": "The Asset ID is bound to another credential."
}
```
